paired_ratios.ratio_definition: zjs/qjs within each matched sample pair

compile_ns.reason: zjs parse_ns excludes src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_Eval(COMPILE_ONLY).
compile_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

context_create_ns.reason: QuickJS reports JS_NewContextRaw only, while zjs JSContext.create includes standard-global installation; raw values must not be divided.
context_create_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

context_destroy_ns.reason: phase context_destroy_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
context_destroy_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

context_plus_globals_ns.note: Derived as context_create_ns + (globals_install_ns ?? 0) on each engine. Timing boundaries align, but installed global surfaces differ; see environment.global_surface.

eval_total_ns.note: Complete outer eval boundary on both engines; this is the only published cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute ratio.

first_execute_ns.reason: zjs vm_run_ns starts after src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_EvalFunction.
first_execute_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

globals_install_ns.reason: QuickJS exposes a separate intrinsic-install phase; zjs merges it into JSContext.create and reports null.
globals_install_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

job_drain_ns.reason: phase job_drain_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
job_drain_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

runtime_create_ns.reason: phase runtime_create_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
runtime_create_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

runtime_destroy_ns.reason: phase runtime_destroy_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
runtime_destroy_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

allocation_count.reason: qjs uses JSMemoryUsage.malloc_count; zjs uses JSRuntime.memoryUsage().allocation_count, whose ReleaseFast diagnostic counter is unavailable.

allocated_bytes.reason: qjs malloc_size and zjs MemoryUsage.allocated_bytes use different allocator accounting definitions.

compile_ns.reason: zjs parse_ns excludes src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_Eval(COMPILE_ONLY).
compile_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

context_create_ns.reason: QuickJS reports JS_NewContextRaw only, while zjs JSContext.create includes standard-global installation; raw values must not be divided.
context_create_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

context_destroy_ns.reason: phase context_destroy_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
context_destroy_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

context_plus_globals_ns.note: Derived as context_create_ns + (globals_install_ns ?? 0) on each engine. Timing boundaries align, but installed global surfaces differ; see environment.global_surface.

eval_total_ns.note: Complete outer eval boundary on both engines; this is the only published cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute ratio.

first_execute_ns.reason: zjs vm_run_ns starts after src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_EvalFunction.
first_execute_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

globals_install_ns.reason: QuickJS exposes a separate intrinsic-install phase; zjs merges it into JSContext.create and reports null.
globals_install_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

job_drain_ns.reason: phase job_drain_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
job_drain_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

runtime_create_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

paired_ratios.ratio_definition: zjs/qjs within each matched sample pair

compile_ns.reason: zjs parse_ns excludes src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_Eval(COMPILE_ONLY).
compile_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

context_create_ns.reason: QuickJS reports JS_NewContextRaw only, while zjs JSContext.create includes standard-global installation; raw values must not be divided.
context_create_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

context_destroy_ns.reason: phase context_destroy_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
context_destroy_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

context_plus_globals_ns.note: Derived as context_create_ns + (globals_install_ns ?? 0) on each engine. Timing boundaries align, but installed global surfaces differ; see environment.global_surface.

eval_total_ns.note: Complete outer eval boundary on both engines; this is the only published cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute ratio.

first_execute_ns.reason: zjs vm_run_ns starts after src/exec/eval_entry.zig:118-128 (contextGlobal plus createRootBytecodeFunctionObject); it cannot be divided by QuickJS JS_EvalFunction.
first_execute_ns.note: Use eval_total_ns for the cross-engine compile-plus-first-execute boundary.

globals_install_ns.reason: QuickJS exposes a separate intrinsic-install phase; zjs merges it into JSContext.create and reports null.
globals_install_ns.note: The installed global surfaces also differ; see environment.global_surface.

job_drain_ns.reason: phase job_drain_ns is not registered in phaseComparability; an unchecked phase cannot publish a cross-engine ratio
job_drain_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

runtime_create_ns.note: Add an explicit phase definition only after its two timing boundaries have been reviewed.

allocation_count.reason: qjs uses JSMemoryUsage.malloc_count; zjs uses JSRuntime.memoryUsage().allocation_count, whose ReleaseFast diagnostic counter is unavailable.
